findings.one_line: The advertised exact unrestricted minimax frontier is replaced by a one-sided log-free upper bound; retain the upper result only after retitling and positioning it as such, or supply the missing centered converse.

The adaptive log-free upper claim lacks relevance and theorem-level comparison sentences for the cited closest sequential-design papers Arbour et al. (2022), Zhao (2024), and Neopane--Ramdas--Singh (2024).
